proof_architecture: Finite Markov positive technology; log c plus chi log leisure; full depreciation provides exact savings and hours. Finite-vector value constants by convergent series; candidate logs bounded; all feasible alternatives have summable positive utility parts; concavity/Euler telescope uses nonnegative alternative capital and candidate beta^T s/q tail. Strict utility gap gives allocation uniqueness.

Competitive decentralization is separate: concavity/CRS firm optimum and zero profits; owned initial capital and firm shares; individual household takes aggregate prices as given; linear-budget tangent and tail prove global household optimality. Gross returns/wages bounded on candidate histories bound deviations’ positive log utility. Common identical households need no idiosyncratic complete-market claim.

Partial-depreciation steady state and analytic two-root first-order system; one stable branch. No global nonlinear solution or perturbation-existence theorem claimed. Finite two-state shock evaluation produces exact goods/labor/Euler residual diagnostics.
